note: Media Entity Soundcloud adds a core-Media source plugin (id 'soundcloud', allowed source field types string/string_long/link) and a field formatter (id 'soundcloud_embed'). Depends on media. No admin settings page (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. Config surface: the media type (media.type.<id> with source:soundcloud + source_configuration.source_field), the display formatter (soundcloud_embed with type/width/height/color/options), and one config object media_entity_soundcloud.settings:thumbnail_destination (default public://soundcloud). Metadata attributes track_id/playlist_id/source_id/html/thumbnail_uri come from soundcloud.com oEmbed (getMetadata makes live HTTP calls). Medium cases read back a known thumbnail_destination and a known media type's source field name; hard cases build a real SoundCloud media type and switch a field display to the soundcloud_embed (classic) formatter, verified against live config. All fixtures namespaced mes_* / field_mes_*.

evals.prompt: I want to store SoundCloud tracks as Drupal Media entities. Which media source plugin does the media_entity_soundcloud module provide, and what field types can be used as the source field that holds the SoundCloud URL?
evals.expected_output: It provides a MediaSource plugin with id 'soundcloud'. Its allowed source field types are string, string_long, and link — the source field holds the SoundCloud track/playlist URL.

evals.prompt: With media_entity_soundcloud, which field formatter renders a SoundCloud media item as an embedded player, and what are its main display settings (e.g. the player type)?
evals.expected_output: The formatter id is soundcloud_embed. Settings: type (visual or classic), width (default 100%), height (default 450), color (default #ff5500), and an options checkbox set (autoplay, hide_related, show_artwork, etc.). It renders an <iframe> to the SoundCloud widget player.

evals.prompt: How does the media_entity_soundcloud source get metadata (like the thumbnail and track id) from a SoundCloud URL, and what metadata attributes does it expose?
evals.expected_output: It calls SoundCloud's oEmbed endpoint (https://soundcloud.com/oembed) and exposes the attributes track_id, playlist_id, source_id (tracks/{id} or playlists/{id}), html (embed code), and thumbnail_uri (downloaded to thumbnail_destination).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, where does the media_entity_soundcloud module store the thumbnail images it downloads for SoundCloud media? Inspect the live configuration and report the destination URI.
evals.expected_output: The destination is public://mes_probe_thumbs — media_entity_soundcloud.settings:thumbnail_destination (drush cget media_entity_soundcloud.settings thumbnail_destination).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a media type with the machine name 'mes_intro' that uses the SoundCloud media source. Inspect its configuration and report the machine name of its source field (the field that holds the SoundCloud URL).
evals.expected_output: The source field is field_mes_iurl: media.type.mes_intro has source: soundcloud and source_configuration.source_field: field_mes_iurl (drush cget media.type.mes_intro).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a Media type with the machine name 'mes_podcast' that uses the media_entity_soundcloud SoundCloud source, including a working source field to hold the SoundCloud URL. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create media.type.mes_podcast with source 'soundcloud' and a source field (e.g. via MediaType::create()+getSource()->createSourceField(), or the /admin/structure/media/add UI). The media type must have source=soundcloud and a configured source_field that exists on the media entity.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a SoundCloud media type 'mes_embed' whose source field is field_mes_eurl. Configure its default display so that field is rendered with the media_entity_soundcloud embedded player using the 'classic' player type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.mes_embed.default set the field_mes_eurl component's formatter type to soundcloud_embed with settings.type = 'classic' (Manage display: choose 'Soundcloud embed' format, set Type = Classic). Verified: component type === soundcloud_embed and settings.type === classic.
